description: A static class 'Tokenizer' implementing a lightweight tokenizer that segments C# source code by top-level semicolons and braces, while being aware of strings, comments, and template literals. This tokenizer helps in parsing by producing logical segments of code.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A static class providing functionality to split source code into logical top-level segments considering syntax contexts such as comments, strings, and template literals.

methods.name: SplitTopLevelSegments
methods.description: Splits a given C# source code string into top-level segments based on semicolons and braces, correctly handling string literals, comments, and nested structures.
